resources.string: Ask your administrator for the address. Do not enter passwords or access tokens. Only this address is saved on this watch.
Enter a private wss:// address without credentials, query or fragment.
Server: %1$s\n\nOnly continue if you trust this server. Registration sends this watch’s authentication key over verified TLS. An administrator must still approve pairing.
No saved identity was found. Create one to identify this watch securely.
The saved identity could not be opened. It has not been replaced. Retry or ask your administrator for help.
Enter the private server address provided by your administrator.
Connect to your saved server. If this watch has never registered there, choose the first-time option below.
Not connected. Check the address, network and server with your administrator, then retry. Register only if this watch is new to that server.
Waiting for the server. You can disconnect at any time.
Give this code to your administrator. Wait here while they approve this watch on the server.
This watch is paired. Send a text message.
Checking this watch or finishing the previous operation.
No reply received in time. You can try again.
Message not sent. Enter 1–4000 characters and wait for the current reply.
